environment.description: Process executes within a pivot_root(2) isolated mount namespace where the new root is a tmpfs overlay containing only /var/spool/mqconsumer (empty writeable layer) and /var/log/mqconsumer. The mount namespace is created via clone(CLONE_NEWNS) with MS_REC|MS_PRIVATE propagation, followed by pivot_root to the prepared rootfs. /proc is mounted with hidepid=2 and subset=pid. No symlinks exist in the confined tree. The overlay upperdir is a tmpfs with 10MB size limit. The process runs under a dedicated UID (65534) with no supplementary groups. Additionally, a seccomp-bpf filter (SCMP_ACT_ERRNO) blocks openat(2) calls where the resolved path contains components starting with '..' after the initial working directory prefix, enforced via SECCOMP_RET_TRACE with a ptrace supervisor that validates canonical paths before allowing the syscall to proceed.

config.pivot_root: tmpfs overlay at /confined containing only /var/spool/mqconsumer and /var/log/mqconsumer
config.seccomp_bpf: SECCOMP_RET_TRACE on openat with ptrace supervisor validating canonical paths
